description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayConfigResolver class, specifically testing the parsing and resolution of gateway endpoint URLs and setup codes used in the ai.openclaw.app.ui package.

classes.name: GatewayConfigResolverTest
classes.description: Test class containing various unit tests for parsing and resolving gateway endpoint URLs and setup codes.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointUsesDefaultTlsPortForBareWssUrls
methods.description: Tests that a bare wss URL defaults to port 443 with TLS enabled.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsNonLoopbackCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests that non-loopback ws URLs without TLS are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsTailnetCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests that tailnet (private network) cleartext ws URLs are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointOmitsExplicitDefaultTlsPortFromDisplayUrl
methods.description: Ensures that URLs with explicit default TLS ports omit the port in the display URL.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLoopbackCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests that loopback ws URLs with explicit port are parsed correctly.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLocalhostCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests parsing of localhost ws URLs.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsAndroidEmulatorCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests parsing of Android emulator network addresses (10.0.2.2).

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsPrivateLanCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests parsing of private LAN IP addresses.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsMdnsCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests parsing of mDNS hostname URLs.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsIpv6LoopbackCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests parsing of IPv6 loopback URLs.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsIpv4MappedIpv6LoopbackCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests parsing of IPv4-mapped IPv6 loopback URLs.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsCleartextLoopbackPrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Ensures that URLs attempting to bypass loopback restrictions are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsNonLoopbackIpv6CleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests that non-loopback IPv6 URLs are rejected.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLinkLocalIpv6ZoneCleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests parsing of link-local IPv6 URLs with zone identifiers.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsSecureIpv6ZoneUrls
methods.description: Tests parsing of secure IPv6 URLs with zone identifiers.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsUnspecifiedIpv4CleartextHttpUrls
methods.description: Tests rejection of URLs with unspecified IPv4 addresses.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointRejectsUnspecifiedIpv6CleartextWsUrls
methods.description: Tests rejection of URLs with unspecified IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLoopbackCleartextHttpUrls
methods.description: Tests that loopback http URLs are accepted.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeAcceptsRawSetupCode
methods.description: Tests that a raw setup code string is accepted unchanged.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeAcceptsQrJsonPayload
methods.description: Tests extraction of setup code from a JSON payload obtained via QR code.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeRejectsInvalidInput
methods.description: Tests that invalid input strings are rejected.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeRejectsJsonWithInvalidSetupCode
methods.description: Ensures invalid setupCode fields in JSON are rejected.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeRejectsJsonWithNonStringSetupCode
methods.description: Ensures JSON with non-string setupCode fields are rejected.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeRejectsNonLoopbackCleartextGateway
methods.description: Rejects setup codes referencing non-loopback cleartext URLs.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeResultFlagsInsecureRemoteGateway
methods.description: Checks that insecure remote gateways trigger errors.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointResultFlagsInsecureRemoteGateway
methods.description: Verifies that insecure remote URLs are flagged with errors when parsing.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointResultAcceptsLanCleartextGateway
methods.description: Checks parsing of LAN (private IP) cleartext gateway URLs.

methods.name: decodeGatewaySetupCodeParsesBootstrapToken
methods.description: Tests decoding of setup code strings into URL and bootstrap token.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigPrefersBootstrapTokenFromSetupCode
methods.description: Ensures that bootstrap tokens from setup code are preferred when resolving connection config.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigDefaultsPortlessWssSetupCodeTo443
methods.description: Verifies default port assignment for wss URLs lacking explicit port.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigManualPreservesBootstrapTokenWhenNoReplacementAuthExists
methods.description: Checks that bootstrap token is preserved when updating connection config manually without changing auth.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigManualDropsBootstrapTokenWhenNoReplacementAuthExists
methods.description: Ensures bootstrap token is dropped if a password is provided.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigManualDropsBootstrapTokenWhenEndpointChanges
methods.description: Verifies bootstrap token is reset if endpoint hosts change.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfigAllowsPrivateLanManualCleartextEndpoint
methods.description: Tests that manual configuration allows private LAN endpoints.
